content.text: I found no documented Lumen steps for changing a login email when the old inbox is inaccessible, and no identity-verification requirements. Ticket t003 is an account-category, high-priority request with only the customer's text: they changed their work email, the reset link goes to the old inbox, and they ask how to switch it. Two searches for email-change or verification guidance returned only unrelated tickets (t015 display name, t016 email preferences, t007 and t013 billing, t009 a suspected intrusion), so the answer needs to come from a support-documentation source I can't reach with these tools.
